test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Seven girls Mansi, Shweta, Monika, Payal, Aarti, Kajal and Laxmi are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Payal is to immediate left of Mansi. Mansi is third to the left of Laxmi. Kajal is not an immediate neighbour of Aarti. Shweta is second to the left of Kajal. Who is sitting third to the left of Monika?
solution: Seven girls Mansi, Shweta, Monika, Payal, Aarti, Kajal and Laxmi are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). 1) Payal is to immediate left of Mansi and Mansi is third to the left of Laxmi.
